scope: Independent serving finalizer source and readable official-baseline embedding review; no GPU execution or serving promotion.
source_findings: M1/H4096/K8/BF16/CUDA with caller-compatible FP32 scores, BF16 weight and int32 local IDs satisfies the metadata guard; M32/128/256 retain the original kernel.
Two kernels retain weight inside the FP32 norm, inverse-only scratch, original separate FP32 element multiplies and final BF16 cast; fusion disabled on both launches.
Invalid IDs mask x loads to positive zero; zero-slot norm and score arithmetic is retained, including exceptional-value propagation.
Scores, weights and IDs are made contiguous; unsupported shape/device/dtype metadata falls back. All inverse and output positions are written without shared global scratch.
The complete original baseline remains byte-identical inside the diagnostic. Its functions resolve only the appended local finalizer; no imported module or reference is modified.

fixed_gate.activation: Both new kernel names in affected profiles; old kernel in controls.
fixed_gate.comparator: Same-run official stock baseline, not the faster247888 incumbent.
fixed_gate.interpretation: Practical predeclared consistency gate, not statistical significance or end-to-end serving evidence; failure closes the fixed design except a concrete correctness fix.

limits: Actual Triton compilation, reduction/rsqrt/FTZ behavior, BF16 GPU numerical agreement and resources remain untested.
CPU pointer/mask adapter and loose host tolerance are not GPU correctness proof.
Auxiliary stride handling has source/copy and metadata checks; no real GPU strided-tensor or two-stream/captured-graph test ran.
Official first diagnostic only covers the stock Marlin BF16/H4096/K8 boundary and its official shapes.
No provider, official API, GPU, account, budget or serving source mutation by this reviewer.
